title: Handley Page Halifax EB199
memorial_details: Black, rectangular plaque mounted on a light-wood backboard. Outline of a Halifax bomber and the dedication (printed?) in white, upper-case letters. This memorial in attached to a tree, presumably facing the crash site.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF THE MEN WHO DIED/ON 22 OCTOBER 1943/ AT ATLEY HILL, SOUTH COWTON/ YORKSHIRE/ (names in column on the right)/ (outline of Halifax bomber)/ 1664 HCU HALIFAX V EB199 ZU-H TRAINING/ (sponsor and installation date)
